thread:
Kara M: Quick sync — I pulled together an 'echo' synthesis of incidents from Oct–Mar. Found 4 repeating triggers and a set of pragmatic mitigations. TL;DR: ~40% reduction in recurrence possible with 4 low-effort changes. Posting owners + timelines.

Raj P: Love it. Can you paste the short list? I can own autoscale fixes.

Kara M: Sure — short list: 1) cache warmup misses -> proactive warming + TTL tuning. 2) autoscale race on rapid burst -> cooldown adjustments + immediate burst pool. 3) quantized-model OOMs on long sequences -> enforce max_seq per variant + preflight checks. 4) rollout config drift (env mismatch) -> rollout guardrails + env diff check.

Sophia L: For #1 I can prototype a warming job. ETA 2 weeks?

Chris T: For #2 I agree with Raj, but note we need eng-infra approval for burst pool budget. I'll loop infra and flag cost.

Raj P: I can start a spike this week for cooldown tuning. ETA 5 business days to get measurements and a tuning proposal.

Maria G: For #4 I can add an env-diff check to the deploy pipeline. Should be ~3 day effort (including tests).

incident-bot: New action items created: #INC-2112 (cache-warmup), #INC-2113 (autoscale-burst), #INC-2114 (quant-oom-mitigation), #INC-2115 (deploy-env-diff).

Kara M: Proposed owners & handoff dates: #1 Sophia (INC-2112) — 2026-04-10. #2 Raj + Chris (INC-2113) — 2026-04-17. #3 Chris (INC-2114) — 2026-04-24. #4 Maria (INC-2115) — 2026-04-07. Please confirm or reassign.

Sophia L: Confirmed. Will post a short runbook for the warming job and include a smoke check. Example warming cron snippet: ```bash
# warms top-k keys after deploy
curl -sS -X POST https://internal-warm/schedule -d '{"model":"redwood-q2","keys":50}'
```

Raj P: Confirmed. I'll also add a metric dashboard for "autoscale_miss_rate" and send a short investigation doc.

Chris T: Confirmed on INC-2114 spike. I'll coordinate with runtime for preflight checks and memory caps.

Maria G: Confirmed and will open a PR for the pipeline env-diff check this week, plus a gating test.

Kara M: Great — I'll do a two-week follow-up check-in (thread update + status board). If anyone hits blockers before then, ping me or add details to the action item. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
